candidate.subject: Your annual price changes October 15
candidate.heading: Your plan will renew at $60 a year
candidate.body: Your current price is $48 a year. Unless you cancel in Billing by October 14, 2026, your plan will renew for $60 on October 15, 2026. If you cancel, access continues through October 14, 2026.

meaning_map.explanation: The opening sentence identifies the person's current annual price before introducing the change.

meaning_map.required_meaning: The plan renews automatically for $60 a year on October 15, 2026, unless canceled.
meaning_map.explanation: The subject signals timing, the heading states the new annual price, and the body ties both to renewal if the person does not cancel.

meaning_map.required_meaning: The person can cancel in Billing through October 14, 2026, to avoid the renewal charge.
meaning_map.explanation: The body gives the deadline and consequence, while the link names the Billing destination.

meaning_map.required_meaning: Cancellation before renewal preserves access through October 14, 2026.
meaning_map.explanation: The final sentence states when access ends after cancellation.

rationale.state_accuracy: The email distinguishes the current $48 annual price from the $60 renewal price and ties the change to the October 15 renewal.
rationale.actions: Review Billing names the destination containing the renewal and cancellation controls instead of using the vague Learn more label.
rationale.hierarchy: The subject announces the timed change, the heading names the new price, and the body explains the old price, renewal consequence, cancellation deadline, and continued access.
rationale.voice_and_tone: The wording is direct, neutral, and respectful. It avoids promotional claims, euphemism, pressure, and vague timing.
rationale.economy: The email preserves every material price, date, choice, and consequence within the limits without repeating the full explanation in every field.
